extracted.intended_audience: printers, typographers, book designers, compositors and typesetters
extracted.subtask_description: Selecting and evaluating typefaces and typographic settings using printed specimens that show families, sizes, styles, and scripts. The page is a specimen sheet illustrating how typefaces render in different point sizes, weights, leadings, languages, and special characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPECIMENS OF TYPES IN USE
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall header for the sheet of examples showing typefaces and typographic variants in actual use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page presents repeated running text, all-caps display lines, numerals, and miscellaneous signs across many named type families and point sizes so the reader can judge appearance, legibility, and suitability for different uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: MONOTYPE
rubrics_metrics.description: Heading showing the Monotype family specimens in multiple point sizes and leadings (e.g., TEN POINT CUSHINO NO. TWENTY-FIVE).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specimens show the same body text (the Polybius paragraph) set in Monotype at different sizes and with labels like [Solid] and [Leaded] so printers can compare weight, texture, and legibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: CASLON OLD STYLE
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens labeled CASLON OLD STYLE shown at multiple point sizes (eight, ten, eleven, twelve, fourteen, etc.) with variants and sample paragraphs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each size displays the same running text, occasional display lines in ALL CAPS and numerals (1234567890). These let the reader assess Caslon's appearance at text and display sizes, and behavior when leaded or solid.

rubrics_metrics.name: SCOTCH ROMAN
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens under the heading SCOTCH ROMAN shown in different point sizes (e.g., ten, eight, eleven) and with both body-copy and display lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Body paragraphs, display caps, and numerals illustrate Scotch Roman's text readability and graphic impact at varying sizes and weights.

rubrics_metrics.name: BOOKMAN OLD STYLE
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens labeled BOOKMAN OLD STYLE presented at several point sizes (six, eight, ten, twelve, etc.) with body text and display lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare a more open, heavier old-style face across text sizes; includes examples of both solid and leaded composition to show texture.

rubrics_metrics.name: POINT SIZE (SIX, EIGHT, TEN, ELEVEN, TWELVE, FOURTEEN, ... SIXTY)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit enumeration of point sizes (SIX POINT, EIGHT POINT, TEN POINT, ELEVEN POINT, TWELVE POINT, SIXTEEN, EIGHTEEN, TWENTY, etc.) for each face.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each specimen shows the same text at the named point size to allow direct visual comparison of legibility, spacing, and tone across sizes; also used for display-versus-text decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: LEADED vs SOLID
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimen labels repeatedly mark settings as [Solid] or [Leaded].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether extra leading (line spacing) is applied; specimens let the reader judge the effect of leading on readability and page color. '[Leaded]' and '[Solid]' are shown alongside identical text to compare the two settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: ITALIC / ITALIC VARIANTS (e.g., CASLON OLD STYLE ITALIC, ELZEVIR ITALIC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Italic variants of families (italic headings and samples) are shown, e.g., Caslon Old Style Italic, Elzevir Italic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specimens demonstrate the italic cut for emphasis and its readability at text sizes, enabling evaluation of harmony with roman cuts in the same family.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONDENSED OLD STYLE / EXTENDED OLD STYLE
rubrics_metrics.description: Width variants such as CONDENSED OLD STYLE and EXTENDED OLD STYLE are displayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specimens show how condensed or extended widths affect line length, word spacing, and overall color, informing use for narrow columns or display headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: ALL-CAPS DISPLAY LINES (e.g., 'THE FIRST TIME THAT THE GRAND PROSPECT HAD BEEN HELD')
rubrics_metrics.description: Uppercase/display lines are printed at multiple sizes and in different families to show headline appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These samples allow assessment of cap weight, tracking, and visual impact for titles and headings versus body type.

rubrics_metrics.name: NUMERALS AND RUNNING NUMERIC SEQUENCES (e.g., '1234567890')
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequences of numerals appear in specimens alongside text to show figure design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeral sequences and their spacing are provided so designers can judge tabular and in-text numeral legibility and compatibility with surrounding text.

rubrics_metrics.name: MISCELLANEOUS SIGNS
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated section 'MISCELLANEOUS SIGNS' with samples of symbols and punctuation at multiple point sizes (six, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows how mathematical, editorial, and decorative signs render in each face and size, important for technical texts, tables, and ornament use.

rubrics_metrics.name: MULTI-SCRIPT SUPPORT (GREEK, ANTIQUE GREEK, INSCRIPTION GREEK, PORS0N GREEK, HEBREW, ARABIC, ETHIOPIC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens include non-Latin scripts: multiple Greek cuts (Porson, Antique, Inscription), Hebrew, Arabic, Ethiopic, each at point sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates availability and design of corresponding cuts for other languages/scripts, allowing assessment of script harmony, diacritic fitting, and multilingual composition suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: TYPOGRAPHIC CONTRAST & TEXTURE (BODY PARAGRAPH 'When thoughtful Greeks like Polybius...')
rubrics_metrics.description: The same body paragraph is repeatedly used across families/sizes to show overall text color, contrast, and texture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using identical running text makes it easy to compare x-height, stroke contrast, word spacing, and the resulting 'color' of a block of text in different faces and sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: DISPLAYS OF LETTERFORMS AND SPECIAL GLYPHS (CAPITALS, SMALL CAPS, ACCENTED FORMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Samples show uppercase lines, accented forms, and language-specific glyphs within each family specimen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These examples let the user evaluate the design of capitals, the presence and styling of small caps or accented characters, and suitability for headings, inscriptions, or scholarly editions.

rubrics_metrics.name: FONT-NAME HEADINGS (e.g., 'NO. 8 OLD STYLE', 'FRENCH OLD STYLE', 'CHELTENHAM OLD STYLE')
rubrics_metrics.description: Various named faces and trade names are shown as headings with their specimens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each named heading identifies a distinct metal/type/face available for selection; the specimen under each heading is intended to guide choice by direct visual comparison.
